text_en: These are the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn Amnon, by Ahinoam the Jezreelite; the second Daniel, by Abigail the Carmelite;
text_cn: 以下是达味在赫贝龙生的儿子：长子阿默农，他的母亲是依次勒耳人阿希诺罕；次子达尼耳，他的母亲是加尔默耳人阿彼盖耳；

text_en: the third Absalom, son of Maacah, daughter of King Talmai of Geshur; the fourth Adonijah, son of Haggith;
text_cn: 三子阿贝沙隆，他的母亲是革叔尔王塔耳买的女儿玛阿加；四子阿多尼雅，他的母亲是哈基特；

text_en: the fifth Shephatiah, by Abital; the sixth Ithream, by his wife Eglah;
text_cn: 五子舍法提雅，他的母亲是阿彼塔耳；六子依特兰，他的母亲是达味的正妻厄革拉：

text_en: six were born to him in Hebron, where he reigned for seven years and six months. And he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
text_cn: 这六人是他在赫贝龙生的。在那里作王共七年零六个月；在耶路撒冷作王共三十三年。

text_en: These were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four by Bath-shua, daughter of Ammiel;
text_cn: 在耶路撒冷生的儿子：史默亚、芍巴布、纳堂和撒罗满：此四人是由阿米耳的女儿巴特叔亚所生；

text_en: then Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,
text_cn: 还有依贝哈尔、厄里沙玛、厄里培肋特、

text_en: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
text_cn: 诺加、乃费格、雅非亚、

text_en: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
text_cn: 厄里沙玛、厄里雅达和厄里培肋特九人：

text_en: All these were David’s sons, besides the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
text_cn: 以上都是达味的儿子，未记妾生的儿子；他们有一个姊妹名叫塔玛尔。

text_en: The descendants of Solomon: Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
text_cn: 撒罗满的儿子勒哈贝罕，勒哈贝罕的儿子阿彼雅，阿彼雅的儿子阿撒，阿撒的儿子约沙法特，

text_en: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
text_cn: 约沙法特的儿子约兰，约兰的儿子阿哈齐雅，阿哈齐雅的儿子约阿士，

text_en: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
text_cn: 约阿士的儿子阿玛责雅，阿玛责雅的儿子阿匝黎雅，阿匝黎雅的儿子约堂，

text_en: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
text_cn: 约堂的儿子阿哈兹，阿哈兹的儿子希则克雅，希则克雅的儿子默纳舍，

text_en: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
text_cn: 默纳舍的儿子阿孟，阿孟的儿子约史雅。

text_en: The sons of Josiah: Johanan the firstborn, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
text_cn: 约史雅的儿子：长子约哈南，次子约雅金，三子漆德克雅，四子沙隆。

text_en: The descendants of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son;
text_cn: 约雅金的儿子耶苛尼雅和漆德克雅。

text_en: and the sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,
text_cn: 被掳充军的耶苛尼雅的儿子：沙耳提耳；沙耳提耳的儿子：

text_en: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah;
text_cn: 玛尔基兰、培达雅、舍纳匝尔、耶卡米雅、曷沙玛和乃达彼雅。

text_en: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei; and the sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah, and Shelomith was their sister;
text_cn: 培达雅的儿子：则鲁巴贝耳和史米； 则鲁巴贝耳的儿子：默叔蓝和哈纳尼雅并他们的姊妹舍罗米特；

text_en: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed, five.
text_cn: 默叔蓝的儿子：哈叔巴、敖赫耳、贝勒基雅、哈撒狄雅和犹沙布赫色得五人。

text_en: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah, his son Rephaiah, his son Arnan, his son Obadiah, his son Shecaniah.
text_cn: 哈纳尼雅的儿子培拉提雅，培拉提雅的儿子耶沙雅，耶沙雅的儿子勒法雅，勒法雅的儿子阿尔难，阿尔难的儿子敖巴狄雅，敖巴狄雅的儿子舍加尼雅。

text_en: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. And the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
text_cn: 舍加尼雅的儿子：舍玛雅、哈突士、依加耳、巴黎亚、乃阿黎雅和沙法特六人。

text_en: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.
text_cn: 乃阿黎雅的儿子：厄里约乃、希则克雅和阿次黎冈三人。

text_en: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
text_cn: 厄里约乃的儿子：曷达委雅、厄里雅史布、培拉雅、阿谷布、约哈南、德拉雅和阿纳尼七人。
